name: project-echo
description: A cross-platform AI speaking companion with a floating teleprompter, live speech tracking and project-aware answers.

scripts.check:electron: node --check electron/main.cjs && node --check electron/preload.cjs && node --check electron/ai/secureCredentialStore.cjs && node --check electron/ai/aiManager.cjs && node --check electron/ai/providerRegistry.cjs && node --check electron/ai/providers/anthropic.cjs && node --check electron/ai/providers/openaiCompatible.cjs && node --check electron/knowledge/bm25Engine.cjs && node --check electron/knowledge/documentChunker.cjs && node --check electron/knowledge/documentExtractor.cjs && node --check electron/knowledge/documentManager.cjs && node --check electron/knowledge/knowledgeController.cjs && node --check electron/meeting/systemAudioController.cjs && node --check electron/scripts/scriptController.cjs && node --check electron/scripts/scriptManager.cjs && node --check electron/speech/deepgramProvider.cjs
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb --x64

extendInfo.NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: Project Echo can capture system audio only when you explicitly start meeting-audio capture.

linux.synopsis: AI speaking companion with a floating teleprompter
linux.description: Project Echo is an AI speaking companion with live speech tracking, a floating teleprompter and project-aware answers.
